reconcileDrift: Core domain, component and root implementations have been ingested and compile, but their current tests do not yet provide explicit scenario-named evidence for every acceptance scenario owned by the core-domain package. Existing production files and tests are preserved.
goal: Add deterministic, scenario-named domain, Store/component and Decompose root tests that exercise every acceptance scenario owned by core-domain, including success, failure, idempotency, lifecycle, cancellation and time-zone boundaries; do not weaken assertions or change production code.
acceptanceCriteria: Every listed AC has at least one explicit scenario-named executable test at its required core-domain surface.
Tests use deterministic fakes, virtual time where needed and assert exact failure causes and idempotency behavior.
Store tests cover intent-to-state and label sequences; component/root tests cover navigation, stable IDs, back and lifecycle behavior.
Tests do not duplicate production algorithms or modify production sources.
The specialist reports any production-contract gap as a blocker rather than making the test pass by weakening the scenario.
The specialist does not run Gradle or edit the delivery ledger.
